title: Elk Bugle Tube Kit (3-part telescoping + diaphragm frame)
description: Two telescoping resonator tubes (mouth funnel + flared bell section) and a horseshoe diaphragm frame for a latex reed you supply. The tubes amplify and deepen mouth-reed sounds.
use: Nature-study / hobby accessory; use lawfully. Mouth parts: see hygiene note.
material: PETG, 0.2 mm layers, 3+ perimeters. Latex/dental-dam film is NOT included.
assembly: 1. Slide tube B over the straight end of tube A (slide-fit, 0.25 mm radial play); about 55 mm overlap gives the compact pose, pull out for lower pitch.
2. Tape or stretch your own thin latex / dental-dam reed across the diaphragm frame (frame is only a holder; film not included).
3. Hold the frame against the roof of your mouth ONLY after washing it well; or leave the frame out and use it as a mouth-reed training holder in front of the funnel.
4. Blow through the funnel end of tube A; extend or shorten tube B to change pitch.
fit_notes: Joint clearances: press-fit joints are modelled with 0.10 mm radial clearance (0.20 mm on diameter); sliding joints 0.25 mm radial. If a press-fit is loose wrap one turn of PTFE (plumber) tape or a dab of glue; if tight, sand lightly - do not force. Not tested by test-printing or acoustic measurement. Sound depends on your printer, filament, reed film and fit - expect to tune. Hygiene: 3D-printed plastic is porous; wash with warm soapy water, never share mouth parts, adults only for the mouth frame.
fit_check: parts built in assembled pose and boolean-intersected pairwise: no interference found
